sentences.text: JUDGMENT

This appeal is against the order dated 17.01.2017 passed in MVC Nos.601/2013 c/w MVC No.602/2013 on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi, by which the tribunal while partly allowing the claim petitions filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 had exonerated the respondent- Insurance Company from payment of compensation on the premise of driver of the offending vehicle-TATA INDICA did not have valid and effective driving license at the time of accident.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the reasoning assigned by the tribunal on issue No.2 at para 19 and liability of payment of compensation at para 34 of the impugned order are contrary to the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of MUKUND DEWANGAN VS.ORIENTAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED (2017) 14 SCC 663.

entities.text: MUKUND DEWANGAN VS.ORIENTAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED (2017) 14 SCC 663
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As such the order passed by the tribunal exonerating the appellant-Insurance NC: 2023:KHC-K:8612 Company from payment of compensation is liable to be set aside.
3. In response Sri. Sudarshan M, learned counsel for the respondent/claimants does not dispute the aforesaid factual and legal position.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.
5.

The Apex Court in the case of Mukund Dewangan (supra) has held that the light motor vehicle would include a transport vehicle and that holder of driving license to drive a clause of "light motor vehicle" as provided under Section 10(2)(d) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is competent to drive a transport vehicle or omnibus, gross vehicle weight of which does not excess 7,500 k.gs.
6. In view of the aforesaid settled principles of law and since no other grounds are urged in the appeal memo, the appeal is partly allowed.
The order of the tribunal exonerating the appellant-Insurance company from NC: 2023:KHC-K:8612 payment of compensation is set aside.

The appellant- Insurance Company is directed to pay the compensation as awarded by the Tribunal with interest as directed thereunder, within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of the receipt of the certified copy of this order.
Appeal is partly allowed and order of the tribunal is modified accordingly.
